Because there is no doubt that the facility was built to get lost in it and to perish in agony. In a creative way, there are not four differently colored ghosts cavorting in this maze, but space shuttles, jumping balls, spiders, small robots and bats. Of course, everything is also riddled with traps - so variety is provided.
Instead of staying away from all of this, the hero whose role we put ourselves in the game is now stuck in this very maze. His name is Nebraska Joe - and any resemblance to the most famous archaeologist in film history is surely just a stupid coincidence. His job is no easier, however, by hopping, climbing ladders, and collecting keys and equipment, he works his way bravely through the hostile environment.

There are four levels to master and to reach the exit of the labyrinth - in the best case, alive ...

Published in Magic Disk 64 1990/03

159121.overview: A typing tutor educational game in a Sci-Fi setting.

159125.overview: Collect the treasures until the key appears. Then head for the door that leads to the next level. Watch out for the tunnel trolls. Came with a maze editor. Created by  David Dixon and Randy Ubillos and released as part of "Arcade Action" game pack.

159126.overview:
Colonel Farenov: another humdinger of a mission for you Captain Ilya Ilyavanovic Gherhinski!
Captain Ilya Gherhinski: Gee Farenov, with friends like you, who needs the CIA?

159127.overview:
A platforming game created by Christian Dombarcher, published in 64'er Sonderheft 85 in 1993. Tailor-made for choleric people: In this game, whoever reaches the ceiling first wins! Hustle and bustle on the playing field for one or two players, lots of sprites, continuously increasing level of difficulty, cheat mode and individual game design through »Sets: These are the highlights of this fun Jump'n'Run game! The remaining files are fetched into the computer using a fast loading routine. When the cover picture appears on the screen, continue with space. 

Now you can display the description of the game with (Instructions). No matter which choice you make: It must be confirmed with space. But wait until both characters have appeared at the top of the screen. In the game the two broomsticks Clean and Clone have to try to drive away the bugs. Use F5 to change the level of difficulty. Alone or in pairs you have to try to ban all the Nasties from the scene. But be careful: If you touch the lively goblins, you will lose one of your lives!

159128.overview: There are a group of scientists in East Germany who want to defect to the West. Problem is the authorities want them to stay to help develop a new weapon. You must fly over five missions to help get these scientists into the West. In the first four missions you must collect six scientists on each mission and take them to a safe house. On the fifth mission you must take these scientists over the border to West Germany. The scientists will stand in the open waving their left hand. Beware of soldiers disguised as scientists. You can tell these because they wave with their right hand. Off course your not just going to fly in without resistance. Soldiers, jeeps and tanks on the ground with soldiers wearing jetpacks in the air all try to halt your mission. KGB Superspy is a side scrolling shoot-em-up. The screen scrolls both left and right. You control your helicopter with the joystick while the fire button shoots your cannon. To pick up a scientist you must lad on him. To release him you must land on the safehouse (a grass roofed hut). You only have a certain amount of fuel but jerrycans can be collected or land on a safehouse to refuel. On the screen are two arrows pointing left and right. These flash to tell you the direction of the nearest scientist. Also seen is your energy bar, score, lives and how many scientists collected.

159129.overview: You have been invited to the Siandown Temple by The old Masters to fight some of their fighters because the Masters believe no Westerner can become a Kick Box Master. Obviously the Masters don't want to be proved wrong so they have arranged for you to face four of their best kick boxers. Kick Box Vigilante is a fighting game with each fight shown from the side shown on the whole screen. You have various moves at your disposal which are controlled by a joystick. Each fighter has five Yin and Yan symbols at the top of the screen and if a fighter is hit then they lose a part of the symbol, lose all five symbols and it is fight over. You have to beat each fighter twice to move onto the next one and if you don't beat them within the time limit then it is game over.

159130.overview: Kick Off is a two-player table football simulator. Each player controls a team of 11 figures which are ordered on four bars for each one (1 goalkeeper, 2 defenders, 5 midfielders, 3 forwards). You can control only one bar at a time. The ball is kicked by rotating the figures on the current bar left or right. Game length isn't time-limited but depends on the total number of goals scored. After four goals have been scored players will switch side and the game will last until another four goals have been scored.

159131.overview: In this game, you're a clown on an unicycle who has to pop balloons that is falling down from the sky. This can be done by moving left and right to catch them all on the head. Further on, you've to form columns instead of popping them. These columns have a nasty habit by getting each time higher and will give you a lesser time to react. However, if you're close enough to the balloon you can kick the balloon and try again. Another way is to catch the 'Pac-Man' that comes down between the balloons. This will eat the balloons that falls on your head. If you miss you'll fall from your unicycle.

159132.overview: Kid Grid is a one player game where the goal is to capture squares to gain points and complete a grid, in order to move to another level. Your character is Kid Grid and your main attributes are maneuverability and a stun gun, to be used against an array of 4 pursuers, whose task is to corner and kill you. The stun gun instantly, but only briefly, freezes the pursuers, allowing the Kid to elude them to continue building the grid. There is an allowance of 3, 5,or 7 stuns allowed depending on the difficulty of the level you're on, and unused stuns are allowed to accumulate as you progress, for use later in the game. Question marks will appear in the course of the game and are valuable assets to capture for points, and the player's point score is lowered if the question mark escapes. There are 5 levels of difficulty, and the player begins with 5 lives. If 10,000 points is reached, another life is allowed. Scoring is as follows: completing a square: 100 points, capturing a Question mark: 100-500 points, and not capturing a question mark: 10 point penalty.

159133.overview: A game created by Arti Haroutunian and Mathman Published in GO64! 2004/03. In order to defeat him, let your mind go and become him.

159134.overview: Want to impress your friends? There's no better way than to rescue them from the aliens who've locked them in an underground maze! You can accomplish this amazing task with Kidnapped! The problem is that you only have 2 minutes to save them all because once the aliens detect you the maze will be set to explode. The maze has 7 doors, six open into hiding places and the last, a black one, leading to the outside. Scattered throughout the maze are keys needed to open the doors. Don't touch the alien guards or they will capture you and all will be lost! Published in ReRun 1989/03-04.

159135.overview: A text adventure in which you play a sheriff in a small town trying to solve a kidnapping case. This game was developed by Robert Young and published as a type-in program in the book "More Games for Your Commodore 64" in 1984.

159136.overview: This is a collection of three mini-games designed to drill in some basic reading and typing skills to the young microcomputer user of the early '80s. The first of the three games (each with four skill levels, demanding faster reflexes) presents the player with falling letters which must be typed correctly before hitting the bottom of the screen... and eventually the game's mascot floats down defying the player to type in an entire word. The second game takes word-typing as a given skill, as the player is now in charge of typing in the full names of icons of common household objects gradually floating down the screen. In the third game, an object is named on the bottom of the screen and the player must punch in the correct number corresponding to the object's icon, displayed on screen. The second and third games have bonus rounds whose gameplay is as the regular rounds, except that the icons are now partially obscured, demanding a certain exercise of player memory faculties.

159137.overview: Known and respected start of radio and TV, Art Linkletter brings his gentle wit into the home in Kids Say the Darndest Things... to Computers. In this program, I ask questions and use the answers that kids provide tp create wonderful and hilarious stories.

159138.overview: With KidWriter your children can create their very own storybook. They'll make colorful scenes, then write a story-line to go with them. There's even music! This unique format lets kids choose their own story and picture settings from a farm to a theater to outer space. Choose from 99 different characters and objects to allow making pictures of almost anything.

159139.overview: Kikugi is a single player single screen puzzle game, developed and published by 576 KByte and released in 1993. Kikugi is an ancient Japanese game of concentration and strategy. The aim is to jump one peg over another, removing from the board the peg that you jumped, ending up with one piece which should be in the center of the board. Multiple levels\game boards are available; each one has a different set number of pieces. Game was published in a two-pack with Tetris from 576 Byte.

159140.overview: A space shooter where the best option is to evade or dodge despite the name. It was created by The Black Cat and released to public domain in Digital Marketing PD #229.

159141.overview: A hack of the German magazine game Missioncode CX-13 which was coded by Stefan Otto. The game was hacked by Stefan Vocke of Butterfly Productions.

159173.overview: Killer is a timed word-guessing game based on Hangman. To save the life the player has to guess the password. The player may choose each of the letters (consonants and vowels), wrong answer causes the gallows to fall one level. Letter panel shows wrong indicated letters and the last chosen one. The game features three difficulty levels.

159174.overview: Caterpillars EVERYWHERE!!! Your beautiful orchard is infested with the leaf munching little beasties and they're rapidly devouring everything in sight. Armed with just your super-lethal bug sprayer, can you possibly wipe them out before tehy gobble up all of your trees? maybe so, .. BUT BEWARE... these caterpillars lay eggs that hatch into devious killer moths and they'll be after YOU!

159175.overview: Your mission is to fly your spacecraft through tunnels in an underground cavern shooting 12 bulbs to move the next level. The game is viewed from the side and the screen scrolls left or right when you move your craft. As you search for the bulbs you must avoid or shoot various creatures and depending on the strength of your shield, if you touch one or hit the walls for too long then you lose one of three lives. Once you have shot all 12 bulbs then you move to the far left of the cavern to hit a switch and move to the next level. There are five levels to navigate with each cavern having the same layout but has more creatures to shoot or avoid. Before you start the game you can select the strength of your shield (1-5) and which level to start on. The joystick or keyboard can be used to control your craft.

159176.overview: The idea behind the game is to shoot anything that moves, this does not include family pets (except poodles). If it moves, shoot it, if it doesn't, shoot if anyway. If by some freak chance you should reach the spaceman, then blow out his heart for some extra bonus points! Each time you play, difficulty increases! (providing you don't turn off!)

159177.overview: A one or two player gambling\betting game released by Lithium Netware in 1992.

159178.overview: You have survived a battle in space but your craft is damaged beyond repair and needs evacuating, so in your emergency landing craft you head for the nearest planet. The planet you are heading for is uninhabitable after a giant brain that controlled all life became extinct, but as you approach the surface it becomes clear that this isn't true as you are attacked by various life-forms. Killing Machine is a top down vertically scrolling shooter where the screen scrolls upwards constantly as you attempt to shoot or avoid various aliens and vehicles over three levels. Getting touched or shot loses you one of three lives and sent to the start of the level you are playing. Certain objects when shot leave behind a power-up which gives you better weapons or a shield which is limited and if you lose a life then you lose your power-up. At the end of level one or two you face a huge Brain Guardian which needs destroying to move to the next level. At the end of the third level is the Giant Brain itself.

159179.overview:
"Ave Caesar! Moriturite salutant! you say and launch your spacecraft!" says the message at the start of each level of this shooter. Not a bad one, with some kick-butt  music. Created by Jens Kleinholz and published in Golden Disk 64 1991/09.  
 
Sophisticated graphics and great sounds for your ears quickly make you forget the frustration of one or the other lost computer life.

159180.overview: A flood of radioactively contaminated meteorites thunders unstoppably towards the earth. Can the catastrophe be averted? A game by Oliver Kirwa and published in both 64'er 1989/01, and in 64'er Sonderheft 66.  It was exactly 11:45 p.m. when the scientist Dr. John Trendham of Mount Palomar Observatory jumped out of his chair in front of the star screen as if stung by a tarantula: A bright flash on the monitor indicated an explosion of unprecedented proportions within our solar system! Excitedly he searched with the Computer control system the coordinates of the flash of light. No doubt: the super nova was exactly at the position of Saturn! What had happened to this planet? But you don't have time for speculation now.

159181.overview: A text adventure game where you kill enemies, take their stash of tools to kill the other 4 enemies on the floor. Get past all five and you'll find 4 more floors of increasing complexity. The more enemies you kill, the higher your score will be!

159191.overview: A vertically scrolling shooter, a ROM hack based on Killwarp by Johan van Berken, this version was released by Cubix-X Soft in 1992.

159192.overview: An early learning game for kids aged 3-8. This program is a collection of 6 learning games: Draw, Scribble, Names, Sequence, Letters and Match. KinderComp helps children improve their reading and counting skills as well as familiarizing them with the computer keyboard.

159194.overview: A very HARD SEUCK game developed by Simon Hillam. This cute'em up shooter game is best played as a two player co-op game and was published in Commodore Zone Issue #08 (November/December 1996).

159195.overview: In Kinetic Connection you are presented with an array of blocks on one of 16 MicroKinema (levels), which are split from a square grid. Pick up, rotate and place the objects to form a mystery image in the grid. You can display the actual image you are attempting to mirror, but your limited fund of time depletes more quickly while this is visible. Puzzles can be broken down into between 4 and 96 pieces. Many of the MicroKinema are animated, which gives you clues as to what should be placed where, and which way up. Quick thinking and creativity are the keys. The puzzles can be saved, and played alone or with a friend.

159204.overview: Kinetik is an arcade adventure which features gravity, inertia and other real physics heavily. You control a round spaceship, which must be guided through the 44+ screens. Collect the letters P,A and X in that order and reach the end to win. There are foes to avoid or shoot – some take objects you have but most merely drain some of your energy. Some walls can also be shot out. Some rooms have white spots which affect gravity and drag you inwards. Avoid contact with red walls as these drain energy; all others are harmless. There are teleporters to help you navigate the game, and power-ups which remove the complex physics.

159205.overview: A graphic and text adventure, not to be confused with "The Search for King Solomon's Mines". You start at a deserted trading post, maybe you can find something to trade the locals to help you get across the ravine and make your way to the legendary mines.

159206.overview: Released as part of "Adventure I" game pack, this is another version of the original Pharaoh's Tomb Adventure where quest to loot King Tutankhamun's tomb and avoid the curse of the Mummy and get out alive. All this by flickering torchlight. So brush up on your snake charming, research how to defeat a Mummy and figure out what scares a goober. Pick up the treasures and get the treasures outside the pyramid to gain points. 175 points is 100% completion.

159207.overview: Released as part of "Bits, Pieces and Clues" and "Interactive Adventures" game packs. Based on the same initial code that the 1979 PET adventure that spawned several versions of this game for different Commodore machines. This is an Egyptian themed text adventure, like the original versions the goal is to score 175 points by collecting treasure. In the game the player starts outside a big pyramid with nothing but some food, some matches and a torch. It's up to the player to explore the massive tunnel systems inside the pyramid in order to find all the treasures. In this version they added easier to read text, and game saving and loading mechanics as well as some small game improvements and bug fixes over other versions of this game.

159208.overview: As a knight, paladin, barbarian or sorceress, amass an army of creatures to take on the local baddies and search for the Sceptre of Order. A turn based game with a time limit that decreases depending on the skill level you play at. Depending on your allegiance, you will initially start with a different set of creatures, though the king will not mind whether you're his knight or barbarian. Game consists of four maps, each with more mean creatures to control and meaner opponents to fight, but acquiring those maps early will let you find and buy some mean creatures that will help you easily conquer prior maps. You can see all the enemies on the map and can literally clear the map of enemies, though random can appear in your castles if you leave them unprotected after the conquest. With each conquered castle (assuming the castle is occupied by the enemy you are currently after), you will get a level up, after first two level-ups king will promote you and you'll be able to recruit cavalries from the castle, after four more promotions you'll be able to recruit knights. All the other creatures are found outside the king's castle and can be recruited no matter the level, although your level determines the quantity of creatures you can find for recruitment, but take care of your money because if you don't have enough for your army's salary, they will desert or turn against you. There are also two artifacts per each map that will also uncover the map of the place holding the King's Sceptre. The moment you find the sceptre and bring it back to the king, the game will end even if you happen to find it very early in the game. As for tougher enemies, like the final one having hundreds of dragons and demons, they can also be defeated, but not by the army you can muster in one go. But when you're defeated, you respawn back at the king's castle and start with almost nothing but your money, however, the enemy in the castle will be left without those creatures lost in the battle, unless some of the new comes to aid him as every week the population increases.

159209.overview: Pretty good if predictable SEUCK game based on the early Hollywood comedies. Your two players are named Charlie (Chaplin?) and Harold (Lloyd?). Created by Carsten Manshusen using Chris Yates' SEUCK engine and published in Game On 1989/02.

159210.overview: A Tron style head to head competitive game with variable playing fields.

159211.overview:
Published in Magic Disk 64 1994/11.

Kitron: The Challenge is a Tron style head to head duel with a larger than normal playing area. This is the first TRON remake with a learning computer opponent. A little routine that artificial intelligence generates lets the opponent learn from his mistakes so that he will not make the same mistake again in the same situation. There is also a brake with which you can drive more slowly in corners. The brake is activated with the fire button. This help has no negative influence, because the opponent also slows down.

Due to the learning effect of the opponent, it can be that the opponent commits obvious "stupidities" in the first 2-3 levels. Don't be surprised - at higher levels you will likely need precise strategies to win. To do this, the game can be paused by moving the joystick in the opposite direction of travel.

Before starting the game, you have the following options/game modes:

•   DUEL MASTER: The game takes place with the opponent on an empty field. 
•   LABYRINTH: The opponent must be caught in different labyrinths that increase in difficulty.
•   HANDICAPDUEL: This mode creates random Barriers on the field of play, requiring increased Player attention.

159212.overview: Klemens is a platform game where the player must rescue eight of his twin brothers locked in the cages scattered around the labyrinth. Destroying the cages requires finding the dynamite. Unfortunately Klemens may carry only one item at a time, so finding a brother without dynamite requires remembering the back route. The labyrinth consists of 256 chambers inhabited by numerous hostile animals and other obstacles, such as ground spikes, bouncing balls or coming from the ground skeletons. Each enemy may be annihilated by jumping on it. Contact with hostile creature or obstacles takes some energy, which may be supplemented by thanks to energy potions and temporary immortality shields.

159213.overview: Klepkomania is a variant of Arkanoid, using well known cartoon graphics as a hidden background. Standard gameplay is diversified by indelible or appearing again block, disturbing birds moving in an irregular manner and various bonuses. The game has no sounds and music.

159214.overview: In English Kljuc is The Key. A simple Croatian Manic Miner  style game with monochrome graphics. An unofficial English translation was released by the cracking group Rappelkiste (RAP) & CBA in 2008.

159215.overview: Knight Orc is a text adventure with graphics. The protagonist, Gringleguts the Orc, swears revenge on all humankind for the treatment of his race. The game flows in real time; each person and creature goes on about their daily lives and follows their schedule. So, if the protagonist revisits an area and finds a person that was previously there gone, it may mean that the person in question is in another location. The player's decisions and timing play a key role to the game's outcome.

159216.overview: An unreleased one player racing game from 1986. Developer is unknown. This should not be confused with the later Knight Rider 2 preview from Christian Widmann. Both are in an Outrun style perspective but are quite different.

159217.overview: A one player preview of a racing\driving game created for the Commodore 64 Crap Game Compo 2006 (C64CGC) and based on the popular 80's television show by Christian Widmann and Mark Thomas Ross. It features the characters K.I.T.T. and Michael Knight.

159218.overview:
This next game could be your last! Knightmare! is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls Sir Legless, a knight tasked with rescuing King Eric and and the other knights imprisoned by the Wizard Anthrax. The player can move in all directions and fires directly forwards. At the beginning of each game the player visits the armoury, and can put points towards crossbow, armor, or shield to modify their character.

The game world is divided into 80 rooms, and in each area enemies rise up from below the ground and attack the player. The player gathers special keys and items which can be used to open particular doors or kill specific enemies. They must also gather a variety of treasures along the way. The player starts with 3 lives, and each life starts with limited energy which is drained by touching walls or enemies.

159219.overview: From the book "Brain Games for Kids & Adults Using the Commodore 64". This is a three-dimensional version of the chess game called "Knight". You might want to try the standard 2-D version before tackling this more challenging version. As the name implies, you might have trouble going to sleep after playing this horror.  You are given a starting point and a finishing point on a three dimensional chess board. The locations are given by a letter A to H, followed by a number 1 to 8 and then another letter A to H. your knight can move a total of six squares in any combination of 2, 2, 2, or 4, 1, 1 or 1, 2, 3. By any combination. For instance, in the 1, 2, 3 move you may move any one of the coordinates by 1 unit followed by 2 units and the remaining coordinate by three units. You must enter your moves in a string containing all the three new coordinates in teh format: Letter-Number- Letter such as F7D. Good luck!

159253.overview: Knights of the Desert is the operational level simulation of Rommel's famous North African Campaign of WWII. The game begins in March 1941 and ends in February 1943 in 12 turns each representing 2 months. Both players goals are the same. That is to sweep across the northern coast of Africa pushing the enemy as far back as possible capturing key towns such as Benghazi and Tobruk along the way. The only difference is the direction you are heading. As the German Commander your main goal is east to Alexandria. As the British Commander your main goal is to sweep Rommel all the way back to El Agheila and win the game. Knights of the Desert provides for solitaire play where the computer directs the British.

159256.overview:
KnockOut! is a boxing game where your aim is to become World Heavyweight Champion of the world by first becoming European Champion. You have to beat the computer fighters three times to become European Champion before beating the computer three times to become World Champion. Before the fights you can choose the stamina of your boxer and the computers from one to four, with one being the strongest. There is also a two player option which just consists of one fight between both fighters. The last option you have is the ability to create an opponent and this allows you to move the boxer around the ring, throw punches and defend with a limited amount of moves before allowing you the chance to fight him.

The fights themselves are viewed from the side with the whole ring on the screen and you take control of the boxer in the red trunks on the right. Each fight consists of four, one minute rounds and you have to knock your opponent down once to win the fight while avoiding being knocked down yourself. You can only move your fighter left and right and throw a left or right punch but you can block punches to the head. As a hit connects with a boxers head, a gauge increases and the speed this increases is how much stamina a fighter has. Once a gauge is full then the fighter is knocked down and the fight is over.

159257.overview: A 2 player only Public Domain boxing game released in Q-Link Disk #27 (1987/09), and in Jim Green PD Disk #29.

159258.overview: The Intelligence Quotient remains the definitive means of assessing brain capacity, and this classic book, originally published in 1962, and recreated in game form in 1985 was the first that permitted readers to determine their own IQ, the game does it much more efficiently. It includes an introduction by the prolific psychologist Hans Eysenck, followed by a range of easy to difficult IQ challenges. When reviewing your answers, your personal IQ rating will be revealed.

159263.overview: Test your own IQ and know how you match up with friends and family.

159264.overview: Split into knowledge, wisdom and understanding sections, the Kobyashi Naru trial must be completed in order to gain immortal status. Collect the required objects from each one in this adventure game. The game offers pictures of each location and significant objects, and a textual description of each location, but beyond this the game system is atypical of 1980s adventures, especially those originating on cassette. A set of icons is displayed in the top half of the screen, which are selected to activate movement, item manipulation, analysing the scene (by selecting specific words of text), and actions like ascending, throwing and swimming. Puzzle solving always uses objects either in the scene description or your inventory.

159265.overview: Koko is a platform game, developed and published by Aackosoft, which was released in Europe in 1985. You are Koko and diligently searching for the Magic Ball that can fulfill all your wishes. But, as always with wishes, you have to do something to get them, not only do you have to exchange the blue sky for a musty subterranean cave, but you also have to take out the patrolling robots and an immortal guard before you can find the Ball and the 23 treasures. Can cherish, ad that takes a lot! A refreshing adventure game.

159266.overview: A simplistic clone of Donkey Kong using simple character graphics published by Keypunch Software, as part of their "Arcade Games I" pack. The player's task is to reach the escape point, which is located on the LEVEL # sign. During the journey, you must avoid rolling barrels and falls from any height. Optionally, you can collect bonus objects hanging on strings, which give you 100-800 points at random. Some parts of the platforms collapse, and if the player passes them all, they receive an additional 1,000 points. The game is created in a character-based system, which is why jumping over barrels and holes is quite problematic.

159267.overview: A timed puzzle that will make you pull your hair out. Created by Boris Müller and published in Game On 1992/02.

159268.overview: Kosmic Kanga is a single player side scrolling action game. The player plays as a super kangaroo that has a jet pack and a gun. The game scrolls sideways right to left and the player must leap over obstacles, avoid enemies and collect bonus items to score points. The aim of the game is to continue playing until Kanga gets back to his space ship achieving the highest possible score along the way. The game is joystick-controlled.

159269.overview: The Kromazone is the elite training ground at the Terran Space Fleet Naval Academy. The fleet's best pilots are put through their paces here. Whoever wants to be a starfighter pilot and maybe one day fight against the Maranzar must survive the Kromazone. Kromazone is a 3-D game where the action is viewed from the cockpit of a MantaRay fighter, which automatically flies forward. In the first level, the task is simply to evade flying balls. Only when this stage is over, the fighter's blasters are activated and the enemy can be shot at. The MantaRay can take a certain amount of hits before being destroyed, and the remaining number is displayed on the bottom of the screen. The game can be played by two players taking turns, who can compete for a high score.

159270.overview: Krymini is a puzzle game in which the player gets presented with a 6x6 grid. Balls with different colours are spread out on this grid, along with some unoccupied fields. The goal is to move every ball once: depending on the colour the ball has to be moved by a different amount of fields. After a ball is moved, it is converted into a permanent stone. Each level has to be solved within a time limit.

159271.overview: Krypton is a side view horizontal scrolling shooter where you control a Superhero (who is obviously a knockoff of Superman) as the screen scrolls from left to right constantly, as you try to save the Earth from attack by Superbeings over various levels. You crashed a space shuttle on Earth after a trip from your home planet, but instead of feeling sorry for yourself, you like living here and so you have vowed to protect your adopted planet from any threat armed with lasers shot from your eyes. One such threat has appeared in the form of Superbeings who intend to destroy you and Earth by using your weakness, Krypton. You must move around the screen shooting the beings who throw Krypton at you while avoiding missiles and more Krypton shot upwards from a Ground Control Pod. If you hit a being, Krypton, missile or the Pod then you lose one of three lives. Occasionally the border will turn blue and this means your Girlfriend is falling off a Skyscraper. You must rescue her before she hits the ground.

159272.overview: A horizontally scrolling space shooter very much in the style of Delta, created by Marc Drolshagen (Lord Armschange), Thomas Kottmann, and Jens-Christian Huss and published in both Game On 1988/11 and Game On 1990/02.

159273.overview: Kulfon w krainie złego demona is a platform adventure game. Kulfon's fiancée was kidnapped and imprisoned in the castle. The player must find a way to rescue by using proper objects scattered in the surroundings, in the castle and the underground level. Kulfon may carry up to two items and interact with encountered characters. Fall from a height or swimming without diving equipment means the loss of life.

159274.overview: A one on one fighting game using backdrops from Kung Fu Master. The game was developed by William Fong and published in Your Commodore 1986/03.

159275.overview:
Game was available both as the German original and as an English translation. 
The story of the game is relatively bleak. After the two brothers Peter and Thomas lost their parents, they moved to a small town and opened a pizzeria there. But even there, after a while, there is no peace, because a gang of protection rackets terrorizes the whole city and demands money from the brothers. When they can no longer pay the increasingly higher protection money, the gang burns down their pizzeria. When they heard about a martial arts tournament in the city shortly afterwards, Peter challenges the leader of the gang: if he defeats him in the tournament, the gang must disappear from the city. But the leader kicks Peter illegally in the head during the fight, and so violently that he dies from it. Thomas swears vengeance on his brother's grave and sets out to free the city from the gang.

159276.overview: After saving the city from a nuclear holocaust and defeating various bad guys in Redhawk, you once again take the role of Kevin Oliver and his alter ego, the superhero Redhawk. You have now been promoted from photographer to reporter for the newspaper The Daily Trumpet, and your first assignment is to go to the mysterious Dr Lee's mansion to find out what goes on inside and to see if he has anything to do with strange disappearances. You also find that you cannot remember being here before but it all seems familiar. Kwah! is a graphic text adventure in the style of a comic book. The screen is split into three parts and the top part has three windows showing pictures and animations of your last three moves and also tells you if any object or person can be seen. The middle part of the screen is a clock, strength meter, how much of the game is completed and arrows showing available exits. The bottom part of the screen allows you to type in commands to interact with your surroundings.

159277.overview: Krazy Kong 64 is a single screen platformer loosely based on the arcade game Donkey Kong where you have to rescue Maidens at the top of the screen held by a giant ape. Starting at the bottom of the screen you must run up the platforms diagonally in the form of steps, with three levels of platforms to navigate. As you run up the screen you must avoid barrels that are thrown by the ape by jumping over them. If you hit a barrel then it is game over and if you reach the Maidens then you can rescue one before attempting to get the next one on a new screen.

159343.overview: Cribbage is a card game that has been popular for centuries. In this adaptation, you compete against the computer in a standard game trying to beat your opponent to a score of 121. Points are scored according to standard cribbage rules: The game gives you a beginner play mode where the computer scores all points for both of you, or an advanced mode (Muggins) where you each score your own hand and can claim any points missed by your opponent (calling Muggins).

159635.overview: Shoot the Rapids allows you to paddle a canoe down various courses of gates on a river and try to complete them within a time limit. The game is viewed from above with the river scrolling vertically up screen when you move and on the river are different speeds of currents. As you move through the starting gate, you must move the joystick (or keyboard) left and right gently to build up a rhythm to move forward and to turn you hold the opposite direction down. To move backwards you hold the fire button down as you paddle left and right. In the corner is a clock with the time moving round and you must complete the course without missing any gates within this time limit or it is game over. Hitting the sides of the river with the stern or bow just slows you down wasting valuable time but hit it with the side of the canoe and you sink.

159981.overview: You have been tasked to go after Alana and get the crystal in your starship called Andromeda but Alana moves around the Galaxy all the time so her known location is rarely known. You need to search the whole galaxy searching for Star Bases to take over to restrict Alana's movements and find planets to find the Lance and the elements to power it.

160398.overview: This is an add-on for SSI's Kampfgruppe featuring one historical mission, Berlin (28 April 1945, designed for Soviet side) and four generic World War 2 scenarios also focusing on urban warfare: Bridgehead, Inferno, Panzer Thrust, Eagle's Nest.

160400.overview:
The Keys to Maramon is set in the same world as Magic Candle.

The Keys to Maramon is an adventure role-playing game where the mission of the characters is to rescue the town of Maramon. Initially, the player can choose from one of several adventurers who have different strengths and weaknesses. The protagonist begins by accepting a position from the mayor of Maramon to protect the town from monsters. The daytime is peaceful and can be spent exploring or resting to recover health. Every night, monsters come from some of the towers and attempt to loot and pillage Maramon. Initially, the player doesn't have any keys to access the locked towers, but by carefully searching and fighting, the player can discover the keys. The towers contain some mysteries, treasure, and ultimately the "source" of the monsters. The game is won by exploring the towers and eliminating the source, which will end the relentless nightly cycle of monster attacks.

160439.overview:
An emigrant ship is stranded on an island. The people took possession of the island and gave it the name "after the sound made by the beams when the village was built". Since then, the settlers have been living independently on the island, apparently without contact with the outside world. The characters of the comic are the descendants of these stranded emigrants. The wreck of the ship serves Backbert and Steuerbert as dwelling. The Fetzensteiner are former pirates who also suffered shipwreck off the island and nestled in the already existing castle. 

The lifestyle and clothing of the people on Knax suggests that the emigrants probably came to the island during the Renaissance . Whether the comic plays in the present or in the past is unclear. Didi and Dodo are the only kids on the island and the only ones wearing modern clothes. They live together and do not seem to have any parents or guardians on Knax.

160440.overview: Kolonialmacht is a multiplayer-only strategy game set in the Africa of 1884. Over the course of a restricted amount of months, three colonial powers try to gain the military and economic lead. One of the most important aspects are mines and plantations which produce the four resources of the game: cacao, tobacco, diamonds and gold. Those can be either sold for money or traded against another of the four resources. After every round the market prices change so the key to success is to anticipate which resource to concentrate on. The military troops are used to proceed against the enemies, either directly against their units or by conquering their assets.

160441.overview:
You were but a simple merchant living in the Realm of Mists, but your life just got more complicated: the pirates who attacked the ship you were sailing on had not only robbed you, but also kidnapped your woman. They have left you alive for one reason: pay the ransom or...

In the game Kupiec the player travels between towns, selling his merchandise (clothing, weapons, jewelery, food, etc.) at marketplaces, buying maps (to search ruins for hidden treasure), asking for information the suspicious types who frequent inns. Random encounters await you on the roads (read: brigands!), so better hire some helpers to form a caravan and travel safely. The game interface is menu driven.

164714.overview: The main character of this game is Kwixx, a bundle of energy that roams around the universe destroying everything in its path. Your job is to create force fields that will block its movements, until you have covered at least 75% of the screen. When you complete an outline of the force field by connecting it to the edge of the screen or with other force fields, it fills in with a certain colour, which changes in each level. There are some enemies to watch out for. Apart from Kwixx, you need to watch out for the spark which moves along the line you awing if you pause for an instant. Also, two primitive particles roam around the edges of the screen and the lines you have drawn. Bump into any of these enemies, or waste too much time in the level, and you lose a life. Lose all your lives and the game is over. Released as part of "Arcade Games II" pack.

164717.overview:
Our hero must reach Melkhior, a somewhat eccentric wizard who is the only one who can save him. As with most Ultimate titles of the day, reaching him is a long and treacherous challenge, involving both puzzle-solving and action, meaning that each screen requires thorough planning and precise navigation. The game uses the isometric viewpoint in a manner similar to the later Head Over Heels, using monochrome but detailed graphics and techniques to avoid flickering sprites. The game lasts for 40 days and nights - at night your character turns into a werewolf. Ultimate's individual style of eschewing straightforward instructions in favor of feature lists and riddles is put to good use here, with the story detailed in a rhyming poem of sorts. 

The C64 version is actually a fanmade conversion and not an official port.

167707.overview:
Produced as a product tie-in with OTA's honey puff cereal, Guldkornexpressen (or Kalaspuffsexpressen) revolves around the brand's bear mascot, who drives a train filled with honey puffs. His task on each level is to pick up boxes of the cereal, add honey and drive the train to the end of the level, where the cargo is loaded into a big box of Guldkorn.

It is not just a straight forward career along the tracks, though. Switches must be set back and forth for the train to go on the right tracks, there are rocks and fallen trees on the track, and you must keep your speed so as not to crash into things. Fortunately for Puff the bear, he has a honeybee friend. By tapping the joystick button, you activate the bee. It is the bee's task to activate the switches and to operate the honey tap. If you hold in the joystick button, you activate an action menu to deal with obstacles. You can choose to jump over fallen trees, throw dynamite at rocks or to let the bear jump out and dig away dirt from the tracks.

168010.overview:
A compilation of all three parts of the so-called Ket trilogy: 

Mountains of Ket 

Temple of Vran 

The Final Mission 
 
Mountains of Ket is an interactive fiction game with role-playing elements. Throughout the game your prowess, energy and luck are developed. You will have to buy items off merchants, as well as finding them in convenient places. Combat takes place on a round-by-round basis will full textual commentary.

168084.overview: You have been kidnapped! You awaken on the ninth floor of a strange building to find that your kidnapper has left you unattended. You must try to escape from the building one floor at a time. Each floor is independent of the others. You cannot carry items from one floor to another and you cannot return to a previous floor. Everything you need to escape from a given floor can be found on that floor! This makes you feel like you're playing nine mini-Adventures rather than one big Adventure. Published in SoftSide Magazine Issue 27 12/1980.

168087.overview: A set of new Kikstart courses created with the Kikstart Construction Set created by Nitro and The Illusion.

168089.overview: This game was the source of much confusion due to the fact that Kikstart C16 is a C64 port of the C16 version of Kikstart, and not a C16 cartridge. This motorcycling stunt game where you have the option to test your skills in a one player game against the clock. The object of the game is to guide your rider as quickly and carefully as possible through three out of the eight courses you get to choose from before each race. 16 courses that have to be done in order with five lives. Every course has its own level of difficulty and a unique layout of trees, car's, bus's and pools of water for you to avoid by jumping your bike over. You can use your joystick or keyboard to accelerate, decelerate, wheelie and jump your bike from start to finish.

168187.overview: Mathematics and discovery category teaching hypotheses formation and deductive reasoning, mathematics for educational Level: Grade 4—Adult. THE KING'S RULE is an interactive reasoning skills program. The game creates an interactive environment to assist upper-elementary students to look for hidden patterns and explore alternate explanations for observed behaviors of a system.  Colorful figures guard each of the castle gates and present riddles which the student must answer using deductions tested prior to confronting the guard.

168214.overview: Krieg um die Krone is the predecessor of Heirs to the Throne a board game comparable with Risk. In a medieval fantasy scenario, which will be automatically created new with every game start, your aiming to eliminate your opponents and conquer the world by placing your armies and attacking neighbor territories. Tactical gameplay is required, because to win the game, you need to conquer those territories filled with treasure chests. In those treasure quests you will find crowns, orbs or scepters. For each of them you receive an title of nobility which improves your ranking and will be rewarded with additional troops. You will win the game if you're able to get all three of them (crown, orb, scepter). Towards most early games of this kind, you don't need an human opponent, you can play as single-player against the AI.

168320.overview: In this game you take the role of a contestant in the TV game show The Krypton Factor. The gameplay is divided up into different types of mental skill including Observation in which you are told a story and shown a picture. The story is then told again but with subtle changes along with the picture which alters. You must then type in what text has changed and also what has altered on the picture. There are also mathematical puzzles involving you remembering a sequence and working out the sum quickly as the clock is ticking away. As the game progresses there are also physical tasks to do including moving the Ergobuggy around a course and finishing off with a general knowledge quiz.

168465.overview: A brain-memory game for up to 8 French-speaking people.

168472.overview: A Spanish language adventure game where you explore the pyramids and avoid the perils within. You've to find the treasure room inside the pyramid of Keops and escape from it.

168548.overview: Look closely! The program teaches children to observe very closely and trains the memory. It contains two games, some parts of which can be played by more people. The first game (on the A side of the cassette) takes place around farmer Jansen farm and consists of three parts. Images of the animals in the yard appear on the screen, the position, shape and color of which the player has a good idea of must record. The second game (on the B-side of the cassette) is an astronaut selection test. In the beginning, the player is prepared for this. From a series of images from the world of space travel he remembers and indicates the correct position, among other things. In the last part, the test itself can be taken. In both programs, each part can be played at different levels. Developed for children aged seven to twelve.

168568.overview: A graphical treasure hunt for children. The first (and only) game in the Kingdom of Myrrh series. Designed to be an educational adventure game, it covers reading, problem solving, map skills and decision making. You write down clues in your quest to find King Olin of Myrrh, kidnapped by the evil sorcerer Vargor. Anara the wise woman will guide you along on your search.

168569.overview:
Klątwa ("The Curse") is an animated adventure game that takes place in an evil sorcerer's castle. The player moves around its rooms, collects objects and solves puzzles. The goal of the game is to get rid of the sorcerer and lift the curse from the land.

The player points to objects and elements of the scenery and chooses actions such as "Get", "Use", "Open" and so on. Each object or background element can have different actions available. The main character can carry up to five objects in his inventory and is also able to write down nine spells that can be used with nine different objects.

168571.overview: Weird deepspace alien Hatcheries approach, bursting with life aimed at Earth's destruction. All hopes and future happiness reside in you, sole pilot of a fighting ship. Eggs crack and ghastly monsters glide spacewards to wreak their dreadful havoc on our homes. yours is the charge: smash each hatching egg, let none escape and Earth is free. But first the Guardians you must overcome...

168584.overview: A cross between a Snake game and a Pac-Man, collect-em-up, style game.

168585.overview: Finally a fun cassette game for the whole family. Always contains thousands of different crossword puzzles. Many options: printing, checking, fastest time.

168586.overview: An adventure game based on a famous Bavarian Legend. Our hero is Tristan, the honourable Knight. Tristan must save his beloved Isolde from the evil Wumper, bad Baron of Wummerstein. You must control Tristan on his gallant mission within Wumpers's sinister castle. Make sure you possess magic shoes - with these you can fly. Beware the evil Wumper, you must fight him at all costs!!

169580.overview:
Antonio Savona has done it again, after he released his homebrewed conversion of Chopper Command, he promised two more conversions of classic Activision games that were made for the Atari 2600/VCS. This game is the second in the trilogy, and it's a conversion of the beloved 2600 classic, Keystone Kapers.

Game Description:

The notorious thief Harry Hooligan is on the loose! You play the part of Officer Keystone Kelly, sent in to capture Harry. Harry is trapped in a four story mall, and is running as fast as he can to reach the exit at the top. Your job is to catch up to him and send him to prison. You will need to use either the escalators at the end of each floor, or the elevator in the middle to go from floor to floor. The escalators may be further away, but the elevator moves pretty slowly so you will need to decide which route will be faster in getting you closer to your goal. If Harry can make it to the top before you catch him, you will have to retry that level. Harry has no intention of letting you catch him easily, and is hurling everything he can find in an attempt to slow you down. Shopping carts, bouncing balls, biplanes, and more will all be flying past on the screen and will either slow you down or send you back to the beginning if you get hit. As the levels progress, Harry will run faster and faster, and more objects will be tossed your way to duck and jump over.

172228.overview:
Keloglan (stylized as Keloğlan on the title screen) is a Turkish language graphic text adventure for the Commodore 64 published in 1989 by Byte Computer. Keloglan is based on a fictional Turkish character of the same name from the nation's folklore/mythology. Help Keloglan to awaken the beautiful princess from death sleep. Be sneaky! 

Keloğlan,may be the the first Turkish commercial game released (we haven't come across an older commercially available game yet), is an adventure game made with the game editor named GAC (graphic adventure creator). Each screen of the game is graphically represented and the last screen is also available.

174292.overview:
A multi-scrolling Shoot'em Up game published in Super Game 2000 Nuova Serie N°17 (Maggio 1989) in Italy.

This is a pirated version of SAS Combat Simulator from Codemasters

174425.overview:
A platform game originally released by Konami for MSX in 1985. The game plays like Lode Runner, but takes place in Egyptian pyramids instead of ruins. As an intrepid adventurer, the player's goal is to collect various gems, while evading angry mummies and other monsters long enough to find the exit to the next level.  A total of 15 pyramids await us to discover. We can use pickaxes and swords against mummies.

This is an unofficial fanmade conversion for the C64.

175244.overview: One of the sample games shipped with game of "The Graphic Adventure Creator" aka Ransom the King and King's Ransom. Find gold to pay for the kidnapped king's ransom.

176092.overview: A platformer created by Tapani Takamäki and released in 1988 by Mikrobitti. Translated from Finnish into English as "Revenger".

178565.overview: Created with the Boulder Dash Construction Kit and created with Deluxe Packer V1.3, which puts this in 1995.  Later released in the Boulder Dash Golden Edition 04 release.

178641.overview:
You are trapped in the space base of the enemy planet Vectron, defended by sophisticated armaments. To escape you must be able to cross with your astro-fighter various sectors equipped with missiles and laser cannons and patrolled by fierce squadrons of spaceships. Your spacecraft and armed with air-to-air missiles; so do not hesitate to launch yourself into this moral combat where weapons cannot replace reflexes, courage and determination. Remember that the only way to escape is barred by a wall: take it down before crashing into it and get ready to glaze piece by piece the mighty mother ship while avoiding enemy fire in the meantime. Full speed ahead!

Published in Digital Marketing PD #021 as Kill 'em All. 

Published in Published in Hit Parade 64 N°63 (01/1992) as Avanti Tutta.

178643.overview: 100 new levels added to the REM-release of the original Krackout an released for the the DoReCo Party 2014. Game had additional graphics done by Maik Schilling.

178644.overview:
The homebrew sequel to the smash original Krakout. Arkanoid-style Breakout clone, which unlike most other similar games has the bat on the side of the screen (there is a left/right option) instead of at the bottom. 

There are a number of types of special bricks, but unlike e.g. Arkanoid, they do not fall towards the bat. Instead, when you hit a special brick, it flips to show a letter. E.g. E (Extend bat), C (Catch ball), M (Missile), B (Bomb, explodes when hit by ball, clearing a number of bricks) and X (Extra life). Extra lives are also awarded when the player scores 10,000 points.

The enemies/obstacles are more varied than in Arkanoid. Some make the bat freeze, some actually chew and eat your ball and spit out the core back at you!

178646.overview:
The Krakout game is a development of the idea of the Breakout video game released in 1976. The main feature of Krakout is that the racket is not located at the bottom, as it usually happens, but on the left or right (at the player’s choice).

The Professional version is much more challenging to play, topped only by Master Krakout.

179340.overview:
Konami's Arcade Collection is a compilation of Konami arcade conversions containing the following ten games:

Jail Break
Green Beret
Yie Ar Kung Fu
Ping Pong
Yie Ar Kung Fu II
Mikie
Iron Horse (C64)
Hypersports
Shao-Lin's Road
Nemesis

179930.overview: It's all about kissing. The task of the player is to kiss as much and as long as possible with his "mouth". But the player must avoid the hearts, they bind you tightly and don't allow you to kiss new mouths. Nourish the mouth with lipsticks to keep them from becoming over strained, or there will be a serious point deduction.

179935.overview: The Krakout game is a development of the idea of the Breakout video game released in 1976. The main feature of Krakout is that the racket is not located at the bottom, as it usually happens, but on the left or right (at the player’s choice). This, third in the series of Krakout games featured 100 working levels, originally designed with 101, but a problematic one was removed.

180136.overview: Enjoy the fun of making Krakout versions for you and your friends. Moskwa TV's goal was to put out 1000 new levels for Krakout, they never quite made that goal, though 13 Homebrew versions would follow.

180791.overview: A horizontal Breakout\Arkanoid style game created by Pheadra and improved by Moskwa TV of New Order Incorporated.

180829.overview: A German language strategy game where you have to outfight and outmaneuver the Klingon battle fleet.

181070.overview: In this text adventure you must rescue the princess and her jewels. This game was originally written for the Apple by Lance Miklus, adapted for the C64 by Steven Darnold. You have just landed the Millennium Falcon on Darth Vader’s Death Star. Your mission is to rescue the Princess Leia and her jewelry.

181941.overview: All new levels for this Arkanoid-style Breakout clone, which unlike most other similar games has the bat on the side of the screen (there is a left/right option) instead of at the bottom. There are a number of types of special bricks, but unlike e.g. Arkanoid, they do not fall towards the bat. Instead, when you hit a special brick, it flips to show a letter. E.g. E (Extend bat), C (Catch ball), M (Missile), B (Bomb, explodes when hit by ball, clearing a number of bricks) and X (Extra life). Extra lives are also awarded when the player scores 10,000 points.

182207.overview: The Krakout game is an eventual development of the idea of the Breakout video game released in 1976 and the Arkanoid syle that began in 1986. The main feature of Krakout is that the racket is not located at the bottom, as it usually happens, but on the left or right (at the player’s choice).

182302.overview: A version of Krackout made by The Wiseguys for 1989.

182419.overview: Knight Rider: The Board Game is a 2009 public domain computerized homebrew conversion developed by Nathan Butcher. It is a conversion of the 1983 Parker Brothers board game based on the popular 80's action television program of the same name, which made David Hasselhoff a household name, long before his Baywatch days.

185143.overview:
This is the sequel to the first part of the Warriors of Ras series, Dunzhin. All games in this series are early graphical Roguelikes. The story is quite simple: Enter the mystical monster-infested dungeon Kaiv, slay monsters and grab treasures.

You explore the dungeon in a turn-based manner by entering commands in text adventure, like "MOVE NORTH" or "LIGHT TORCH". The commands may be abbreviated by one or two letters. You can also move several squares at once (like "MOVE EAST 3") to speed up your quest. Another very helpful command is "SPEED", which makes the game's messages go by faster. Your progress is hindered by traps (acid pools, slimey floors etc., some of which you can escape by quickly pressing a key), thieves who rob you, random teleports and, of course, by a variety of 24 different monsters, ranging from simple Zombies, Wolves or Dwarves up to Wyverns and Vampires.

The combat system makes the Warriors of Ras series stand out from other roguelikes: Apart from your total hit points, you and the monsters also have hit points and armor for each body party separately. If the hit points of one body part reach zero, you're dead. Each attack must be directed to one of the body parts, some of which are easier to hit than others. You may also "AIM" a hit (which costs some time, but makes the attack more likely to hit) or "FORCE" an attack (this makes it more difficult to hit, but increases the damage). This and the body parts result in a quite tactical combat -- you have to guess or find out the weak parts of your opponent and choose the right way of attacking.

192681.overview: Save the cities! Type the word before it hits the city!! A fun and educational game where you learn to type while saving the world from oncoming nuclear death.

196085.overview:
Robert Meeks wrote and Loadstar published in their 41st issue this text adventure of King Arthur and his quest for Holy Grail that has nothing to do with the cancelled game of the same name that was published to Spectrum few years earlier. 
 
Published in Loadstar #041.

196627.overview:
Your city is under attack by incoming killer saucers. Your mission is to defend your city from the aliens. The aliens will appear from both sides of the game area. They will also attempt to fire missiles and dive-bomb and destroy your armed vehicle. In order to complete each wave. You have to shoot 50 aliens. Be warned though, you have a limited amount of ammo at your disposal. Lives are lost if you are hit by a killer saucer, or its bullets or you run out of missiles yourself. There are 8 levels to play, and you will get no extra lives. Try to rake in as many points as you possibly can. Good luck.

Written partly on theC64 emulation box as part of the CF Power Pack Challenge. 

One of two games release on Christmas Day, 2020 by TND.

199219.overview: Kasino Poker is a computerized poker game for 1 player. It was developed by Bruce Hoins and published on his own label. The year of release however is not known.

205372.overview:
A "cute 'em up" developed by TheReaperUK in 2020 using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit.

From the Author's itch.io page:

A Game for TheC64Maxi/C64Mini/Commodore 64 or a Good C64 Emulator.

UPDATE: Hardcore Mode is now done and Uploaded, This is for Older People and a lot Harder.

A Cute 'em' up (Shoot 'em' up) design for Kids but anyone can play it really, Very easy Game to Play, Shoot the baddies, collect the Balloons for bonus points and try to get a hi-score.

Made with the Sideways Shoot 'Em' Up Construction Kit by Sensible Software and Jon Wells, Also Framework and Music by Richard Bayliss.

Game did not work with framework v2 and v3 (Tile Map Corruption) , but worked with my Hacked up v1 and v2 mixed framework so i spent 3 Days hacking/removing/replacing code from V3, Fixed 1 problem and another would appear but now it is as stable as I can get it and Works fine for this Game.

205387.overview:
An amphibian themed logical/brain game released as part of the following as part of Wicked Software's Big 100 Collection. Also released as part of Robtek's King Size compilation.

Dutch and German translated versions also exist. The German version is still called Frogs 64 (released in Tiger-Crew-Disk #072 (03/2000), but the Dutch version was released under the name Kikkers. Unlike the English and German versions however, the Dutch version does not have a title screen.

206636.overview:
A Football/Soccer arcade style game for 2 players for head to head competitive play. First published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1986/02 (Issue #32), and later in Best of COMPUTE! & Gazette,  Digital Marketing PD #146 and by Australia's Street Games as part of the "Red Pack". Later it would be re-released as Fresh Kicker by Tiger-Crew PD.  There's no such thing as luck in this fast-paced two-player soccer simulation for the Commodore 64 and 128 (in 64 mode). Two joysticks are required. 
 
Defense is just as important as offense in "Kicker," a two-player soccer simulation in which each player controls nine men. You need quick reflexes to protect your goal and to drive the ball toward your opponent's goal.

206935.overview: Keplero (also known as Caverne 2) is a "lander" game from Italy for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Alberto Facchini and published in Next Game #03 (03/1985)

207291.overview:
The Beebots from the insect civilization of BEM are invading the Earth, protected by swarms of Killer Bees, and it's up to a swarm of white bees to stop them.

The player control the white bees swarm, trying to kill the Beebots by flying over them and stinging them. The longer the swarm flies over a Beebot, the slower it moves, until it finally stops and dies. When a Beebot dies, a grave marker will be raised in its place, making the movement of the remaining Beebots more difficult. The red Beebots move clockwise, the blue ones move counterclockwise.

The Beebots are protected by swarms of Killer Bees. If a swarm of Killer Bees attacks the player's swarm, it will lose its bees gradually, until none are left and the game is over. The longer the Killer Bees stay on screen, the stronger they get. They'll change their colors gradually, from green (the less harmful) to blue and then finally to red (the most dangerous).

The only defense the player has against the Killer Bees is the bug-zapping RoSHa Ray, released by pressing the action button. It is recharged each time a Beebot is killed, and it follows the white bees swarm vertical movement. Once all Beebots are killed, the round ends, and a new one starts with a new level of difficulty. There are 26 difficulty levels.

The player scores one point per sting, ten points per zapped swarm and 100 points per Beebot killed. At the end of each round, a bonus is also given, consisting in ten points per each survivor bee, multiplied by the number of the round.

208684.overview:
Katabatia is a classic style roguelike for Commodore 64. Decend 20 floors to recover the Amulet of Yendor and return with it.  

Features

    Three classes, with four gods to worship. Sacrifice gold to improve a deity-specific stat.
    Three endings.
    Full joystick control, using menus for inventory interaction, etc.
    Spells, Potions, and special weapons and armor.
    Pour potions over equipment to change their magical abilities.
    Switch between animated, graphical tiles, or static text-mode graphics.
    SID soundtrack or sound effects.

Originally designed for a single-button joystick, control is limited to 4 directions. With only one button to work with, you must hold the button to enter the menu. A button tap causes a turn to pass. Version 1.1 added keyboard commands. The game does not delete saves on death, but it does count how many times a game has been loaded, so it will know when someone has beaten the game in one sitting.

209181.overview: Köszönöm means Thank You in Hungarian. The game is a simple action game, a mash up of Monstro Gigantro and one level in Donald Duck's Playground where you catch items and put them in the correct sorting crate.

209479.overview: Kacper is a platform adventure game. Kacper's fiancée was kidnapped and imprisoned in the castle. The player must find a way to rescue by using proper objects scattered in the surroundings, in the castle and the underground level. Kacper may carry up to two items and interact with encountered characters. Fall from a height or swimming without diving equipment means the loss of life.

210034.overview: Knoorkie is a platform game, where the player - as a pig named Knoorkie - must find a solution to defeat a dragon, harassing local residents. The task requires solving many puzzles, finding useful objects, performing tasks ordered by the inhabitants. The action takes place in the castle and its surroundings, such as forest, coal mine, abandoned village, undergrounds. Defeating the dragon requires the acquisition of 20 horseshoes scattered throughout the area (depriving him of immortality) and a silver sword to lop off his head.

210284.overview: According to CommodorePlus, Kong by Sputnik World isn't an exact clone of the Panorama Game & Watch 1983 game, but it is a personal version which has been enriched to make it more enjoyable and far more vibrant. As in brief from the author, not only are the decorations somewhat more widespread than in the original and slightly more enriched in their setting, but higher detailed characters, a new technique used with the Kong Jr. graphic / image on the game's splash screen as well as a collaboration with  Narcisound , who has done a fantastic job in the musical section.

210346.overview:
Krakens is a short casual arcade game.

You play as a swimmer who has to clear blocks by swimming all around them while avoiding to collide with krakens.

There are three types of blocks:

    Diamonds. These count toward the total score
    Key. Opens a portal to access the next level
    Algae. Will slow you down
    Heart. Will add one life

There are 16 levels overall. Good luck!

215961.overview: A German language trading and strategy game for up to 4 players, created by Michael Eisermann & Oliver Schablitzki and with music by Stephen Gogolka. Intended to be close to the popular Ariolasoft game, Kaiser. However this game was a homebrew homage. An attractive simulation set in the Middle Ages. Become Emperor!

215962.overview: A one or two player strategy trading game created by Michael Härtig & Frank Weinhold and released to PD in 1993.

215963.overview: A single screen arcade style platformer aka Kangur from Slawomir Skrzyñski and released by FET in 1993. Kangaroo is an adaptation of an early 80's game released on Atari and Arcade platforms. The story and the gameplay remain unchanged. By guiding the kangaroo mother, the player must reach the top of the board to rescue an imprisoned kangaroo child. Numerous monkeys will try to interrupt the mission by throwing or dropping apples and knocking the kangaroo off the platforms. The kangaroo mother has the boxing gloves, which allow knocking out the monkeys with a single punch for a short period of time.

215964.overview:
Fight against the flying intergalactic alien bases and watch out for their defense machines and defeat the Tarxon empire and save the inhabitants of the Earth save them from their extinction. You'll come up against "alien spore replicants", spaceships, robots, defense turrets and all kinds of obstacles ... You'll have to fly over the various tunnels and reach the main node where you'll find the alien Big Boss. Beat him...!
The project was implemented in "Seuck Sideway L v3.0 Sensible Software 2008" by Pinov Vox, ingame music by Richard Bayliss and Vg Vox, title music by Vg Vox (2020).

- Port 2 or 1  Joystick to guide your space ship.

215970.overview:
A German language "complete" chess program aka Profi Chess released in 1987 by Falken Verlag GmbH and Ariolasoft. "Das komplette Schach-programm" was developed with the intention of taking chess programming into a new direction. It is designed not only for the beginner, who would like to play against an appropriate chess partner, but also for the hobby player, who wants to systematically increase his play strength and become acquainted with the reasons behind the play. Also, the advanced amateur, who would like to sharpen his training on combinations, finds an instructor, with an ideal game interference with many options in the open structure of the program.

In the "Spielen" (Play) section, heavy emphasis is made on opening variations that can be practiced, by allowing the player to study the opening library that is available on the disk. In the program section " Trainieren" (Training) short lessons are available to the user, as well as stored diagram test positions all created to increase your chess knowledge, in all three stages of the game -- Opening, middle and endgame.

The program plays strictly according to the international chess rules, possesses a problem solving function, which solves up to mate-in-nine chess problems. A “Save Game” is also available and the program recognizes and names the twenty most important chess openings.

215971.overview: An addictive action arcade game created for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition by Ali Pouladi & Marukpa and with music by Richard Bayliss. How long can you hang on before falling to your death?! Use joystick in port 2 to play. You can choose the difficulty level at the beginning. Press and hold the SPACE key at any time during the game to go back to the difficulty screen.

215972.overview: Kung Poo Fighter game for the Commodore 64, from 2020 Reset 4K Craptastic GameDev Competition. It certainly doesn’t mean crap, although it can! Craptastic can mean ludicrous, bonkers, outrageous, funny, wacky, far out, and silly. The theme simply implies that the compo was just for a bit of fun, not a serious coding competition. Competitors were welcome to make an excellent game to submit for the compo, or games that contain some humor or silliness to fit more with the theme, but they didn’t have to! The competition was limited to 4KB. Yes, any entry submitted could be no more than 4KB when compressed! In this action game you must focus your Shi... and block the bog rolls or get wiped out completely!

215973.overview: “Kur pelīte tu tecēji?” is a Latvian folk song about a little mouse. This game from Snauts follows that song and puts you in the roll of the mouse in this action game where you avoid the bats.

216003.overview:
You have been assigned to go to the sb77 space base, there to take up the battle with the dreaded space drillers. Since it has been known that the base has large stocks of polished diamonds, the base has been suffered by a continuous wave of terror and looting. Your task is to, with the help of a completely newly developed machine that can bounce back a ball lightning and allow its energy to be released on its impact against any other object that comes in the way of this powerful natural phenomenon, to say the least, take coal on the robber gangs and recover the stolen diamonds , as well as other things that you can catch up with your bounce machine. You move your bounce machine by pulling the joystick right/left. 

If you hold fire at the same time you can move the machine twice as fast. You can affect the sideways movement of the ball lightning by letting the ball bounce on the outer parts of the machine (outside the shock absorbers). On the right resp. Left side. You will have extreme use of this to keep the lateral displacement of the orb at a stable level, as the lateral displacement is affected when the orb hits a robber ship from below. Good luck!

217443.overview: Ka-Rasy Eight's is a computerized single-player version of the popular card game crazy 8s. It was developed by John O'Hare and Jim Green, and released into the public domain in 1987.

217444.overview: Kaboom is an unofficial homebrewed conversion of Activision's Kaboom! for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Sacha Kerres and released into the public domain in 1984.

217626.overview: King Albert is a solitaire card game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Maurice Jones and published in Loadstar #190 in 2000.

217627.overview: King's Audience is another solitaire game from Maurice Jones. This one was released in 1999 as part of Loadstar #183.

218718.overview:
Krptar is a 1-player side-scrolling arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Endangered friends and neighbors in your land above the equator have had a tough time finding the secluded lair of some drug dealers living and working deep in the tropical jungle to the south. They have been raising forbidden plant life and concocting illegal brews. These terrible suppliers must be caught, and their deadly deeds stopped. As Principata of the cities in your country, you decide to man a "search and fight" helicopter. You quickly find the fields and manufacturing plants, but are besieged by protector ships.

Played from a side perspective, the player controls a helicopter than can move in all directions. The helicopter can fire straight to the right. Enemy vessels approach from the front and behind, and the player must destroy 8 enemy radar ships to advance to the next level. The player starts with 3 lives.

219077.overview: Kombiniere is a German language 1-2 player competitive Tetris clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Eugen Traeger, and released as part of the "64'er Lern-Spiele" sample disk which was included in 64'er 07/1993.  The game pieces presented must be placed in the container in such a way that a horizontal row is always fully occupied. A full row is deleted. If the rows cannot be fully occupied, the rows of games pile up. If the container is full, the game is over.

219118.overview:
The Konia project is a game for C64 where you can play 3 games "inside" a Nok... ehm, an old "Konia" cellphone, while funny text messages entertain you. 
Hitting spacebar in-game makes you warp in the "crazy mode", where a game switches to another game suddenly. 
Hitting spacebar during the menu choice picks a random chat to show.
Can you reach 255 points and break the "indestructible" phone?

219121.overview:
This is the C64 port of Colin Garbutt's puzzle game from 1992, Kye.
The reason I made this port was primarily technical: I wanted to implement a game in 6502 assembly involving hundreds of active objects interacting with each other, and push graphical limits at the same time by augmenting hi-res graphics with a dynamic sprite overlay. Kye was the perfect candidate for this experiment, since it saved me the trouble of having to come up with my own design, and it's a mostly forgotten game with a lot of user-made levels that's definitely worth a bit of fresh attention.

The goal of the game is simple: move around with the green circle thing and collect all the diamonds. It's up to you to discover the rules!

219789.overview:
The kingdom has been overrun by slimes! Choose your knightly hero and clean up!

Knights & Slimes is a brand new, arcade-style platform game for the Commodore 64 (the greatest 8 bit computer of all time).

Features:

-    Fast-paced, single-screen arcade platforming action.
-    Random levels so every game plays differently.
-    8 knight characters to choose from.
-    4 different world areas to play.
-    Slimes, monsters, and more slimes!
-    Epic magic spell power ups.
