-    Gain experience points to earn new abilities for your knight.
-    EasyFlash and Ocean cart images.
-    Automatic saving to the cart image (EasyFlash only)

219837.overview: This is my entry for the game-making compo at Zoo '22 Commodore 64 demo party. You are a knight in a maze. Your goal is to eat all of the bits of bread in order to score points and move to the next maze. Wandering throughout the maze are many skeletons who are trying to catch you. Your knight has the ability to temporarily turn into a ghost and be able to pass the skeletons. To do so you will need to pick up the potions located throughout the maze. The maze also contains numerous doors. The knight can move these doors to reconfigure the maze and outsmart the bones brigade coming after you. Each level also has bonus items for points, each bonus gotten without dying add a streak bonus. Fire to turn into a ghost. F1 to change pink doors, F3 to change yellow doors and F5 to change green doors.

219969.overview: An avoid-it action game for two (only), created by Phil64 and released for the CSDb C64 Fun Compo 2021. Avoid everything. Survive as long as possible.

344956.overview:
A one or two player Polish Yahtzee variant that included gambling. It was created by Michal Kasza and published in 1993 as part of "Kosci & Poker" game pack. 

Kości zostały rzucone is a classic 5 dice game for up to three players (human or computer), including records of the results and three roll trials.

417738.overview: A rare game rescued from the oblivion for the pleasure of the C64 games collectors. The original version was from 1983 by pli micro, updated with docs and fixes and re-released on December 4, 2022 by Hokuto Force. A game of the 10 different levels of the labyrinth. You can choose male or female protagonist. Created by Christina and Mike Levine.

418696.overview:
The Kingdom of Craal is an unofficial conversion of a 1985 Amstrad text adventure for the Commodore 64. The original Amstrad version was done in BASIC by Mike Bibby. The C64 conversion was done in 2012 by Steve Bakke, also In BASIC. The game was originally released as a type-in game in a 1985 issue of Computing With the Amstrad magazine.

Story:

Far, far away, beyond the Ice Mountains, lies the weird and wonderful Kingdom of Craal with its magnificent palace, crystal clear lake and enchanted forest.

It is a peaceful land, ruled for many happy years by King Meek who was respected by most of his subjects for his good nature and integrity - and his rather dishy, if inefficient, handmaiden Jajut.

There was one character however who was not party to this overwhelming admiration - Vadham the evil wizard.

Many years ago, he was banished to the castle dungeons for trying to nick the king's gold-plated penknife -the one with a special blade for taking stones out of horses hooves.

In his spare time when he was not mixing spells or playing Ghouls, he turned the dungeon into a labyrinth of despair, where only the brave had the courage to enter. Having said that, we haven't seen any of them come back yet.

You were born in Craal the handsome son of a cobbler and many years ago you decided to seek a fortune in far off lands.

You returned many times over the years to visit your old mum and dad and spend the occasional happy hour in the company of the king's daughter, Andrea.

What was once a childhood crush on his heir blossomed into love, and you have returned for good to claim your bride.

Alas, on this last visit, you found the king dead and the palace in uproar. The wizard had taken a heaven sent opportunity and, as the king opened the door down to the dungeons to let out the castle moggie, he grabbed his magnificent gold crown and disappeared into his hiding hole in the depths - better than a penknife no doubt, but not much use for getting things out of horses hooves.

You, in your typical youthful manner, were only interested in your future wife - Andrea. The palace guards, the footmen, the courtesans and even Ethel the cleaner, however, were not impressed with your infatuation and by a unanimous decision volunteered your services to retrieve the crown.

They threw you head-over-heels down the dungeon steps with a warning that should you return empty-handed all your beloved possessions will be forfeit, even your subscription to Computing with the Amstrad -they'll stop at nothing, some people.

Well, you have your challenge, and you don't really have much option but to accept it.

In this serious adventure, you have at your disposal six single letter commands. These are n, s, e, w, I and i - for the four compass directions, look and inventory respectively.

The program will also accept other standard adventure commands such as take, drop, hit and say.

418701.overview:
Kilodium is a fast-paced, rather difficult mini-game shoot 'em up for the Commodore 64. It was inspired by the Andrew Brawbrook C64 classic, Uridium.

The game was developed by Aleksi Eeben and released as part of the Minigame Competition 2006 - 1K Category.

It was also released as part of GO64! 2006/03-05.

The game has no title screen, and goes right to the gameplay after loading.

419114.overview: Killer Crabs is a fixed screen shooter in which you play a crab at the bottom of the screen that must shoot its enemies to survive. The game was developed by Paul Ranscombe and published by Noik Software in 1984.

421113.overview: It is supposed to be about farming crops, feeding pigs and turning them into sausage.

425218.overview: Kick of the spear is a fast-paced 1 and 2 player fighting game, compatible for both PAL and NTSC machines. A dark cloud has descended upon us and the realm i overtaken by the fierce god Anubis, who has once again risen from the underworld to spread fear and death. you need ton enter his lair and defeat all the villains guarding his hideout, before facing the menace himself in order to save the world!

425279.overview: A two player only versus arcade game brought to you in 2023 from the JamuTeam of Janne Olkkonen and Mikko Happo. The game was being developed by the guys back in 1992 but it was not finished until 2022 Christmas. Finally released 10.2.2023 after 30+ years after the project start. Attack your rival without hitting the edge of the arena. The first person to touch the edge of the arena loses.

444284.overview: Inspired by the popular smartphone/Facebook game "Candy Crush Saga" (2012). Kondi Krush is a Commodore 64 puzzle brain game released in 2024 by AnyStone Games.

446676.overview: A cross between Pacman and a labryinth game. Collect all the pills and keys to get to the next level, avoid the randomly moving enemies. Included in Commodore Info 1989/#04. Original version in dutch language, unofficially translated in English later on.

446721.overview: New Enhanced Release - Kazik in the Underworld of Tema - Kazik and the Ghosts enhanced by Laxity and Onslaught

448244.overview:
To become a master you must enter the Dragon Temple and defeat various fighters spread over nine levels. You enter as a red belt and your ultimate goal as well as defeating all the fighters is to become a 5th Dan black belt.

The game is a beat-em-up and viewed from the side with the screen scrolling when you move. You must fight each fighter one at a time and must defeat them to move to the next one. You have various moves at your disposal by pressing the fire button and holding the joystick in various directions. Moves include high kick, punch and leg sweep. You can also produce a bamboo stick to help you in your mission.

You and your opponent have various bars and these represent various parts of the body and decreases when hit. If one reaches zero then either your opponent has been defeated or you lose one of nine lives. When you move up to a new level you receive nine more lives. One unique feature about the game is if you leave the joystick alone the computer plays for you until you press the fire button.

452279.overview: A SEUCK based platform shooter created by Keith Killilea (Knightcoder) with music by Paul Kubiszyn & Marco de Jong. It was released in Europe in 1998, the game appears to be a freeware\PD game, but included copy protection that was cracked by Cromance, so there may have been a shareware\compilation aspect intended prior to the publishing of this game.  Enemies assault you from all sides as the game shifts from a horizontal scroller to a vertically scrolling shooter that eventually transforms into platforms.

453853.overview:
The Kung-Fu Master Thomas strolls through town with his girlfriend Sylvia. Suddenly, the two are attacked by several figures. While Thomas is distracted, Sylvia gets kidnapped. Thomas later finds a message from Mr. X, the owner of the Devil's Tempel. The message reads: "We have your lovely girlfriend Sylvia. If you want to save her life, come straight to the Devil's Temple. The five sons of the Devil will then attend to you."

The Temple consists of 5 hallways (levels), that have to be done in a certain amount of time (each 2000 points). Furthermore do Thomas and his opponents have life energy. Thomas' energy is also not allowed to reach zero, or else you need to repeat the level. All items and creatures that are only touched feed upon this energy. While dwarfs and henchmen, items and animals do have only little life energy, the knife thrower, however, needs to be hit twice. The end bosses have as much life energy as Tom. There are only points for fended off end bosses during an attack.

455763.overview: Neppis is an outdoor toy car sport from Finland where you and your friends take turns pushing your small plastic car on a track built on sand.

456474.overview: Katics was made  for the C64 Cassette 50 Charity competition.  It's a little arcade game with few levels and no sound effects due to size limitation of the competition, all code and data is located below $1000 (4K) in the c64 memory.

456706.overview:
Klondike Bill is a 1984 text based gambling game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Tim Hartnell and Brett Hale and published by Interface Publications as a type-in game from the book "The Big Fat Book of Commodore 64 Games".

471252.overview: A retro-inspired breakout game for the Commodore 64! Smash bricks and conquer cosmic levels

473578.overview: Its and educational cyber crime fighting game, where you have to utilize your cyber crime fighting skills to hunt down the cyber perpetrator. This will take you on a digital trip around the Nordics.

475048.overview: Welcome to the Kingdom of the Seven Stones, where thee, the curious stranger, enters the realm to embark on a journey of epic proportions. The land is fraught with peril and danger, but thou art undaunted, for thou art a hero of great renown. Thou roam the land, seeking quests to undertake, and those in need of aid. Thou art a beacon of hope, a shining light in the darkness, and thou will make right what wrongs exist in this realm. The fate of the kingdom rests on thy shoulders, and thou must not falter in thy quest to bring peace and prosperity to the land. May God watch over thee on thy journey, and may thou emerge victorious in battles against the forces of darkness that threaten to consume the realm.

480733.overview: The road never ends, and neither does the traffic.

480745.overview: Eat all human in 1.5 minut max for each level!avoid the enemys in the rooms

480762.overview:
A level and sprite mod version of Krakout, created and released by The Secret Drawer. An Arkanoid-style Breakout clone, which unlike most other similar games has the bat on the side of the screen (there is a left/right option) instead of at the bottom. There are 100 screens to be conquered.

There are a number of types of special bricks, but unlike e.g. Arkanoid, they do not fall towards the bat. Instead, when you hit a special brick, it flips to show a letter. E.g. E (Extend bat), C (Catch ball), M (Missile), B (Bomb, explodes when hit by ball, clearing a number of bricks) and X (Extra life). Extra lives are also awarded when the player scores 10,000 points.

The enemies/obstacles are more varied than in Arkanoid. Some make the bat freeze, some actually chew and eat your ball and spit out the core back at you!

480877.overview: Roleplay game based on the Finnish national epos Kalevala. Game mechanics is based on the Kalevala Roolipeli book published in 1995. Player is Väinämöinen and he told Ilmarinen that he will seize the Sampo. So the story begins...

481061.overview: Guide KegMan through the maze and collect every single white hop, but watch out for the four brewery guards. Three of them hunt you down relentlessly, while the fourth wanders the maze unpredictably. One touch and your brewing career is over!

481989.overview:
This game was made in 64 hours  as entry  for the first Lemon64 AI competition.
Leap from platform to platform, avoid stubborn koalas, turtles and seagulls, and collect all the fruit. Some treats are easy to reach; others take a perfectly timed jump. Can you save the feast?

482132.overview: A relaxing four-river voyage. No enemies, collisions, jumps, or obstacles. Paddle on a glowing cave river, a forest river, a countryside river, and a city canal. Just drift, steer, listen to the gentle 3-voice SID tune, and enjoy.

482133.overview: KARATE FINAL ROUND! is a fast karate tournament game for the Commodore 64. Choose 1 of 8 karateka from Japan, Sweden, the USA, China, Nigeria, India, Belgium or Brazil. Then fight your way through the quarter final, the semi final and the final. You can punch, kick, block, sweep and use the flying kick across 6 stages: a dojo, Mount Fuji, the Great Wall, an Indian palace, a sunny beach and the Moon Temple at night. Each round starts with REI and HAJIME!, and an empty energy bar means IPPON! Play with joystick or keyboard, with SID music and sound effects. Made by READY 64.
